Add support MD5/SHA1/SHA256/SHA384/SHA512 on Windows. It use CryptoAPI. Unfortunately, SHA256 nor SHA384 nor SHA512 are not supported on Windows XP and Windows 2000, and therefore I haven't tested those functions yet.
Add LZMA test, more detailed comments about the sorry state of LZMA magic number checks, update Makefiles to include lzma reader and lzma test.
ZIP reader: added support for XZ, LZMA, PPMD8 and BZIP2 decompression
tar: add new options to allow fine-tuning of --preserve-permissions
Add a new tar option --clear-nochange-fflags that causes file system flags which might prevent the removal or modifiction of files to be cleared before attempting to remove them.
Add a new API, archive_write_set_passphrase_callback, for encryption.
Bring the code supporting directory traversals from bsdtar/tree.[ch] into archive_read_disk.c and modify it. Introduce new APIs archive_read_disk_open and archive_read_disk_descend.

First step towards integrating Mac OS "copyfile" extension from Apple. This part adds probes for the copyfile.h header, and adds a new command-line option --disable-copyfile, which does nothing on non-MacOS systems.

Add --lzma and -J options to cpio. Add tests for these. Edit the existing compression tests so they correctly distinguish unsupported options (e.g., we're testing GNU cpio) from unsupported compression.
Add support for -n option from GNU cpio.
Add support to sparsify files on write. This scans output blocks for NUL bytes and seeks if a block is full of NULs. This is optional, but the penalty is very small.
Add support for TAR_WRITE_OPTIONS and TAR_READ_OPTIONS environmment variables to set default options to writing or reading archives with bsdtar.
Add support for PPMd to 7-Zip writer.
Support for reading Mac OS-style metadata blobs. This adds support for such blobs to archive_entry and extends the tar reader to identify the special entries and store them in the archive_entry.

Improve test coverage: * Add new tests of archive_{read,write}_open_{fd,FILE,filename} * Refactor the corresponding code to reduce the number of unreachable   cases and eliminate a lot of duplicated code.  In particular,   {read,write}_open_filename now simply invoke {read,write}_open_fd to   handle handle the fallback case of reading stdin when called with an   empty filename. * Eliminate the unnecessary "open" callbacks; "open" callbacks are   never needed (I plan to eliminate them from the API someday).
Add experimental support for HFS+ Compression.  - bsdtar provides --hfsCompression option.
Add 7-Zip writer. This writer supports Copy, Deflate, BZIP2, LZMA1, and LZMA2, but 7-Zip's filters such as BCJ are not supported.
Add support for xar reader.
Add new APIs that pass passphrases for reading and writing encrypted archives.
__archive_get_umask: add linux support
pax: add "align" write option for reflink-friendly archives
7zip: Simplify decode_encoded_header_info
endian: Add new 24 bit functions
rar: reset low-distance state for new LZ tables
7zip reader: add LZMA + RISCV BCJ filter (#2403)
7zip writer: support multithreaded zstandard compression (#2391)
7zip writer: initial support for zstandard compression (#2137)
Add --long write option for zstd (#1962)
uudecode filter: add missing check for failed malloc
contrib/archivetest: add raw archive support and print file modes
unzip: add NetBSD implementation of getline() if not supported
Add support for rar5 sfx files
Added support of deflate algorithm in symbolic link decompression for zip archives
RAR5 reader: add more checks for invalid extraction parameters
Add HAVE_STRNLEN to config_freebsd.h
Add support for decompression of symbolic links in zipx archives
zstd: Add support for files created with pzstd
7z reader: support Delta filter with values 2-256
